newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor opens new Queensland plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor opens new Queensland plant.

text.p: Amcor Ltd unit Containers Packaging said it has opened a new A$18 million plastics manufacturing plant in suburban Brisbane to capitalise on growth opportunities in food, pharmaceuticals and beverages.
The new factory replaces two former Containers processing units in Brisbane which have been relocated to the new 21,000 square metre plant, 25 km north of Brisbane.
"This world-class facility reinforces the company's position as one of Queensland's leading plastic bottle manufacturers," Premier Rob Borbidge said in an official opening address.
"The plant will take the company well into the next century, increasing its market share in a range of industries and opening up new export opportunities," Borbidge said.
